evidence.quote: | Some books when books.Books.Customers.IsEmpty && books.Books.Drafts.IsEmpty && books.Books.Invoices.IsEmpty && books.Payments.IsEmpty ->

ARC-REV-01.rationale: Every new rule sits in Tier 2. The transfer format, the check order and the refusal sentences are in Summa.Storage.Transfer. The rules that only new books may be imported into, that GitHub books are refused, and that the files pack is required are in the Summa.Web.Engine transition. The only Tier 3 change maps event names to messages, so Tier 3 decides nothing.

ARC-REV-02.rationale: Transfer.export takes the time as a parameter, and the engine passes ctx.Now. The download and the save are returned as existing effect data (OfferDownload, and SaveBooks via save), and Tier 4 performs them. No clock, I/O or console access appears below Tier 4. Convert and Encoding are pure.

ARC-REV-03.rationale: Schema and Version are single literals. The classification comes from Exports.Classification, and the data version from Exports.dataVersion. The snapshot comes from LocalSnapshot.encode and LocalSnapshot.decode. The new-books predicate is written once. The sentences are each defined once, and the acceptance tests only assert them.

evidence.quote: if v = 2L && declared <> actual then Error "The books in this file do not match its contents."

ARC-REV-01.rationale: The counts-versus-contents rule is in Summa.Storage.Transfer (Tier 2). The preview is built in the Tier 2 engine view from Transfer.read, so no Tier 3 or Tier 4 code re-derives it. The only change outside Tier 2 is the page binding in app/index.html.

ARC-REV-02.rationale: The change adds no effect. contentsOf, the read check and the preview are pure functions of the pasted text and the model. The export still gets its time from the caller.

evidence.quote: | Error why -> $"This file cannot be imported: {why}"

ARC-REV-03.rationale: The count definition itself is single: contentsOf is used by export, read and the preview. The facts about which versions exist and which carry contents are partly restated as the literals 1L and 2L next to the Version literal. Those copies agree now, but they would drift if Version changed. The 'This file cannot be imported: ' prefix is also written both in the import transition (change set 1) and in the new preview, and the two copies agree.
